ceiling_method: best point on the frozen champion's own per-label threshold sweep (pii_holdout_20k, 14 measurable priority tags)
agreement_source: two independent judges over the same 946 datax documents: macro F1 0.4582 across 12 tags with >=30 support (support-weighted 0.4728)
notes: Tag-level precision is measured against gold two judges only agree on at macro F1 0.46: a correct tag the corpus failed to list is scored as a false positive. The measurement, not the model, is the binding limit.
